pr_title: edit text when clicked on with text tool
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/992

1. edit existing text when clicked on with text tool
2. changed default cursor for text tool from `text` to `crosshair`, so that when you hover over text it's distinguished. This aligns it with Figma et al.

Surprisingly, side effect of (1) is simplifying/DRY-ing the code which is a bonus.

issue_context.title: Clicking on text when text tool active should edit it
issue_context.body: When you click on an existing text element while the `text` shape tool is active, it should edit text under cursor, instead of adding new one.
